about: A flow chart built down the frame as it is said: stages joined by arrows, a question with a yes or no (or any named) second way that leads to an outcome or back to an earlier stage, and a named thing passing along the arrows and taking the ways it takes: a process with a choice, a procedure with checks, an order through a factory, a request through a system.

steps.about: the stages in order down the main way, split by |; a question can end with ?

notes.about: a short note in each stage, split by | (empty ones keep their place)

ways.about: each stage's second way as WORD:OUTCOME, or WORD:>N to go back to stage N (from 1), split by | (empty ones keep their place)

main.about: the word on each main arrow down, split by |; left empty it is the opposite of the second way's word (yes for no, pass for fail)

path.about: the words the thing takes at each question it meets, in order, split by |; a question it meets with no word left, or another word, it passes by the main way

thing.about: the name of what passes along, written on its tag; else a plain dot

when.about: moments the thing reaches each stage or outcome on its way, in order; else when their names are said, or one after another
